note: Conal's shortlist of ElevenLabs voice-library narrators (non-American), picked by ear from the previews on 2026-11-09. Pull from here before searching the library again. Library voices need a paid ElevenLabs plan to use through the API (a free key gets 402 paid_plan_required). Don't clone a preview into another model: the owners licensed the voice through ElevenLabs only. In use: british-marilyn and irish-bren in brands/video-toolkit.

scottish-john.name: John - Scottish accent
scottish-john.description: Clear and warm with a mild Scottish accent.

irish-bren.name: Bren - Calm Irish Conversational Voice
irish-bren.description: A calm, conversational Irish voice suited to long-form narration and audiobooks. Reflective, steady and clear, with a quiet authority that feels human rather than performed. Ideal for storytelling and content that values depth, presence and trust.

scottish-anna.name: Anna - Scottish, Warm & Expressive
scottish-anna.description: A mid-40s friendly, warm and expressive female with a well-spoken Edinburgh accent. Relaxing and engaging tone. Flexible voice for travel guides, audiobooks, fantasy, gaming, animation, e-learning, audio, phone systems, screen readers.

british-philippa.name: Philippa - Clear British Narrator
british-philippa.description: Clear, confident British female voiceover with a calm, steady delivery. Best use cases: e-learning, explainers, product walkthroughs and corporate videos. Key qualities: crisp diction, natural pacing, clean studio sound.

british-marilyn.name: Marilyn - Warm Clear, British
british-marilyn.description: A calm, clear British female voice with a warm, reassuring character. Marilyn is well suited to customer-facing voice assistants, conversational AI, virtual receptionists and customer support, bringing a welcoming, approachable tone to everyday interactions. Her gentle delivery also lends itself beautifully to guided meditations, relaxation, reflective storytelling and thoughtful narration.
